### A great well made product.

I love the pink color and especially like the construction. It is made very well and is also lightweight. I am more than pleased with my purchase and would recommend this to everyone who needs one.

Feb 24, 2026

### Awkward going downhill

The safety instructions say not to use this on grades steeper than 15 degrees, and I see why, but that's not very realistic. I've found that using it backwards down hills is a lot more comfortable to me than doing so forwards, but then I'm at risk of tripping. The best solution for me is to remove the piece going across the frame so that I can sit in the seat and carefully scoot myself down hills (the back wheels don't turn, making this nearly impossible to do sitting in the seat the direction it's meant to be sat in). But aside from the downhill awkwardness, I love this thing. It's way easier to walk with compared to my cane.

Apr 10, 2020

# Carex Step 'N Rest Aluminum Rollator Walker with Seat, Rolling Walker for Seniors with Back Support, 6 Inch Wheels, 250lbs Support, Under Seat Storage, for Seniors & Adults, Lightweight, Dark Blue
Brand: Carex Health Brands
Category: Walkers, Rollators & Accessories > Rolling Walkers

## Features
Premium Rolling 4 Wheel Walker This rolling walker for seniors is a versatile 4 wheel walker featuring a padded seat, perfect for holding bags or offering a convenient rest spot. This medical walker supports up to 250 lbs and includes adjustable handles (18-23 inches high) for a customized fit.; Secure Walker with Seat and Wheels Our walker with seat and wheels provides excellent back support, ensuring you always have a comfortable place to sit and rest. Equipped with adjustable lockable brakes and 6-inch premium walker wheels, this rollator walker with seat offers enhanced safety and stability.; Lightweight & Foldable Adult Walker Crafted from durable aluminum, this lightweight adult walker is highly portable. It functions as a folding walker for seniors, easily folding for travel, storage, or transport. The durable seat and wheels for walker confidently support up to 250 pounds.; Sturdy Design with Secure Storage As one of the leading rolling walkers in elderly assistance products, this rollator is built for trusted durability and easy assembly. It includes a convenient underneath pouch for storing valuables, and secure brakes provide confidence and stability for users.

## Specifications
Product Dimensions: 6.13 x 21.25 x 21.63 inches; 14 Pounds; Date First Available: May 4, 2004

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 91.74 USD.
Rated 4.1 from 203 reviews.
Top review: Bought this after my husband fell. Had to find one fast as many people do but was confused with the tons of brands, prices, bells & whistles. This was a good, solid walker. Sturdy. Easy to put together and easy to adjust height. About 8 weeks later and pleased with the purchase. I’d recommend that you buy an attachable cup and cell phone holder to hook on. After much resentment, my husband is now happy with the walker
